headline: WayV takes 'BORN THIS Way' tour to the U.S. in Feb
sub: Four cities from LA to New York, starting Feb 4, 2027

info.title: Tour dates
rows: Grand Prairie · Texas Trust CU Theatre

points.title: What to know
items: The tour kicked off in Seoul in September
U.S. dates were revealed Nov 20 at midnight KST

caption:
WayV is bringing their 'BORN THIS Way' concert tour to the United States in February 2027!

The U.S. leg opens at the Shrine Auditorium in Los Angeles on Feb 4, then heads to San Jose (Feb 6), Grand Prairie, Texas (Feb 9) and New York (Feb 11). 'BORN THIS Way' is WayV's third concert tour, which began in Seoul in September. The U.S. stops were announced on WayV's official channels on Nov 20 at midnight KST.

Which city are you catching them in? 👇
